production_descriptions_source_present.name: production_descriptions_source_present
production_descriptions_source_present.value: "production_descriptions"."source_document_id" is not null or "production_descriptions"."source_url" is not null or "production_descriptions"."rights_status" = 'todam_original'

users_home_city_complete.name: users_home_city_complete
users_home_city_complete.value:
(
        ("users"."home_locality" is null and "users"."home_country_code" is null)
        or (
          "users"."home_locality" is not null
          and "users"."home_country_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'
        )
      )
